title: this friday is much less fun than last friday. 😭 #meangirls #meangirl...
transcript: this was the most fun theater Friday I think I have ever had my favorite thing about the West End is that there are matinees almost every single day I never would have gone to see mean girls if it hadn't been a Friday matinee I mean I've seen Mean Girls out of town, on Broadway and on tour and it has just never been my favorite musical but I had heard they had made significant changes to the West End production and again Friday matinee so Kate and I went and you know what I loved it this is what I wanted means girls to be the book has gotten better there's clearly a very strong concept for what the show is songs have been cut others rewritten and the cast is great I could not believe the changes I was just so charmed by the whole thing and I think we need a west end cast recording because it is so different that was so cute I loved it afterwards we met up with the rest of the group headed over to Canada's Water for one of our faves Phantom Peak Kate, Ben and I did this over the summer and had the best time and seasonally they completely changed the storyline so in the summer it was camp themed now it's JonaCon like Comic Con themed Mickey did full vlog on this you should watch it but Phantom Peak is an open world game theatrical experience you're trying to solve missions Gain points for your team and there's also like silly little side quests our first mission was called unpopular and it was Wicked Themed it was so funny and then our second one was a great British bake off murder mystery it's a four hour experience. It’s a perfect evening with friends. you can also buy food and drinks And the world of phantom peak is so rich the world has lore every character has like a big backstory you could probably do this like three or four times in a single season and not even touch all of it cause there's so much to do this is ben been getting brainwashed and then taking a lie detector test right here honestly it's one of those things that anything you put into it you'll get out of it and just be open to any weird thing that comes your way you know like a superhero battle or a wedding I'm just so happy we got to come back and do Phantom Peak again it was the perfect last big night out in London we did still have one more full day but this felt like the beginning of the end
classificationReason: Clear first-hand review of Mean Girls West End with strong opinions ('I loved it', 'book has gotten better', 'songs have been cut, others rewritten'), but Mean Girls West End is not on the tracked shows list.
